Nora: hey folks, Nora here, first week on platform. Running through the quickstart but `kubectl get pods -n demo-team` gives `Forbidden`. Who should I contact for kubeconfig/namespace access?
Diego (eng-infra): welcome Nora :wave: we handle access. Can you share `kubectl config current-context` and whether you're on SSO or local kubeconfig?
Nora: current-context is `rwd-dev-us-west`, I'm on SSO. `kubectl auth can-i get pods -n demo-team` -> no.
access-bot: ticket INFRA-3217 created for nora@redwood.com. Assigned: Diego. ETA ~20m.
Diego (eng-infra): two quick paths: (1) add your SSO group to the RoleBinding in `demo-team` (persisted), or (2) create a short-lived namespace-scoped serviceaccount token so you can continue the tutorial immediately. Which do you prefer?
Nora: need to finish the tutorial today, so SA token works. Also I'm worried about mixing contexts across terminals.
Diego (eng-infra): ok creating `nora-onboard` SA in `demo-team`. Run this locally to get a token and a dedicated context:
```bash
kubectl -n demo-team create serviceaccount nora-onboard || true
TOKEN=$(kubectl -n demo-team create token nora-onboard --duration=8h)
kubectl config set-credentials nora-onboard --token="$TOKEN"
kubectl config set-context nora-demo --cluster=rwd-dev-cluster --namespace=demo-team --user=nora-onboard
kubectl config use-context nora-demo
```
For context safety: we recommend per-shell KUBECONFIG files like `~/.kube/nora/demo` and exporting KUBECONFIG per terminal, or use our `kctx` helper which shows a big warning when a prod context is active.
Rae: small security note: SA tokens are logged in audits. If you need elevated rights for a demo, request a time-limited elevation via the access portal so it is tracked and auto-revoked.
Samir: also, if you have multiple kubeconfigs merged, run `kubectl config view --flatten > ~/.kube/nora/flat` and use that per-shell. Helps avoid stale user entries.
Nora: ran the token flow and `kubectl get pods -n demo-team` works now, thank you! Diego, feel free to add me to the group if it's easier long-term.
Diego (eng-infra): done: added RoleBinding for `group:developers` in `demo-team` so after your next SSO reauth you won't need the token. I'll revoke the SA token after 8h. Welcome aboard Nora! If anything else blocks you DM me or post in #eng-infra.
